name: Git & Version Control Interfaces
shortDesc: Terminal and graphical consoles for managing branches, staging, and pull requests.
detailedDesc: Interactive staging, interactive rebase, and GitHub CLI workflow.

phase.title: Developer Toolchains & CLI Ergonomics
phase.description: Modern Rust/Go coreutils replacements, Git interfaces, Docker container managers, and polyglot runtime toolchains.

packages.name: lazygit (Recommended TUI)
packages.description: High-performance interactive terminal UI for Git commands. Line-by-line staging, visual rebase, stash management, and conflict resolution.

packages.name: GitHub CLI (`gh`) (Recommended)
packages.description: Official command line tool for GitHub to manage pull requests, issues, releases, and repository cloning.
pros: Create and checkout PRs from terminal

packages.name: GitUI
packages.description: Blazingly fast Git terminal UI written in Rust with microsecond responsiveness even in huge repositories.
pros: Extreme speed and low CPU usage
cons: Slightly fewer advanced interactive rebase features than lazygit
